title: Determine allowed project actions
responsibility: Determines which actions the shown project allows, using reported capabilities and requiring an available operation before enabling comments.

inputs.name: projectCapabilities.bridge
inputs.description: The desktop bridge supplies the optional capabilities reader and comment operation. Its reader is used only when the snapshot has no truthy capabilities, and comments require addComment to be a function.

inputs.name: projectCapabilities.snapshot
inputs.description: The shown project snapshot may state capabilities and carries the project object. A truthy capabilities value takes precedence; otherwise its id is read only if the bridge reader exists and is passed as projectId only when truthy.

outputs.name: closedCapabilities
outputs.description: The baseline capability set used when nothing proves more or as the base for fallbacks. It disables comments, agents, planning, and approval, and sets source to local.

outputs.name: projectCapabilities
outputs.description: Resolves the shown project's capabilities, preferring a truthy snapshot value and otherwise using the bridge reader with a truthy project id when available. A reader rejection yields closed capabilities with a reason; a missing reader enables agents, planning, and approval, while comments are enabled only when the selected value is true and addComment is a function.

examples.reason: This project did not report what it allows.
